name: Unnecessary Stop Script
hint: This smell identifies a [stop this script] block as the final block in a script. Reaching the end already stops that script, so the explicit stop adds no behavior.
instruction: Remove the final stop so the script's natural completion is clear. Keep [stop all] and [stop other scripts] distinct, because those blocks can still affect other execution.
